turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Hale, I've got twenty minutes before a client call. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
Then start with who decided on the zero, Hale. And whether anyone spoke to Owen before it went in.
If you escalate this, I'll make sure the academic integrity committee sees everything, including his two late assignments from September.

Go ahead, Hale. I was going to the principal next anyway, and I want that in writing. I'm writing down "everything, including his two late assignments from September," because late work in September says nothing about this essay.
My call is that the zero comes off today, and Owen gets an apology. Now, what do you have on the essay itself?
